items.title: One loop
items.note: Lenis rides gsap.ticker. Nothing else touches requestAnimationFrame.

items.title: One owner
items.note: Every uniform, every camera axis, has exactly one system writing it.

items.title: Progress, then direction
items.note: Sections write a channel. The director reads the map and stages the scene.

items.title: Tuned by hand
items.note: Aesthetic numbers live in looks/, on a knob — never hardcoded in a shader.

items.title: Measured, not guessed
items.note: The visual gate's thresholds are the rendering's own noise floor.

items.title: Green is not proof
items.note: A build can compile and still break on screen. Verify in a real browser.
